items.title: Game Week - Vanderbilt
No. 5/9/9 Alabama Rolls Past No. 14/15/15 LSU, 31-13, in Baton Rouge
items.summary: BATON ROUGE, La. - No. 5/9/9 Alabama football (7-2, 5-2 SEC) picked up its second ranked road victory of the season, taking down No. 14/15/15 LSU (6-3, 3-3 SEC), 31-13, inside Tiger Stadium. The Crimson Tide scored the final 21 points in the contest within a 9:13 span over the third and fourth quarters to secure the win.
